Box Hill Childcare

Completed project
BOX HILL
Box Hill South, Melbourne
Delivery modelHead contract · AS 4000
CompletionJuly 2026
Building2 storeys + lower ground
LocationBox Hill South, VIC

From permit to handover.

Construction and Development

BOW delivered a new purpose-built childcare centre at Box Hill South as head contractor under an AS 4000 head contract, reaching practical completion in July 2026. The building is two storeys over a lower ground level on a sloping site, with a steel-framed upper level over concrete, outdoor play areas and acoustic fencing. BOW carried the project from permit stage through procurement, authority approvals and completion to handover.

Scope and delivery

  • Permit-stage coordination
  • Procurement and authority approvals
  • Head contract delivery
  • Completion and handover
